name: Newsletter Editor
tagline: Takes your beehiiv newsletter from outline to scheduled issue, one approval at a time.
description: Turns a rough outline into a draft issue, fires a test send to you, and lines up the ad placements around it. Nothing reaches your list until you approve it - scheduling happens only after your sign-off. Made for creators running a weekly beehiiv publication who want the desk work off their plate.
author: sholabuilds
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
